sections.name: MarketGate
sections.note: The weekly market's cement road: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstStalls
sections.note: The first row of stalls: run under, or jump into an awning and bounce along.

sections.name: Hens
sections.note: Two of a vendor's hens loose in the road: jump them.

sections.name: Basket
sections.note: Their basket, left in the road: jump it.

sections.name: HighAwnings
sections.note: Three stalls: a feather high over their awnings for a bounce and a double jump.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: EdgeTree
sections.note: A tree at the market's edge, its low limb across the road: slide.

sections.name: DungBasket
sections.note: Cow dung, then a hens' basket.

sections.name: Flocks
sections.note: Two pairs of hens. A feather over the second, for a double jump.

sections.name: StallsHens
sections.note: A row of stalls, then a hen after it.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: PumpSacks
sections.note: The hand-pump puddle, two ducks waddling from it, sacks of grain unloaded for a shop.

sections.name: LongAwnings
sections.note: A long row of stalls (the potter's among them): bounce along, a feather at the top.

sections.name: FakeOut
sections.note: The potter's pots set out in the road; the rooster knocks a hens' basket in; a goat kid.

sections.name: FlocksAwnings
sections.note: Hens, a row of stalls, cow dung.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a straight.

sections.name: CrowdedRoad
sections.note: Hens, a heap of building sand, a dog asleep, the hens' basket.

sections.name: LastAwnings
sections.note: The last long row of stalls.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: A chilli.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: Hens, a goat kid, the puddle, sacks, hens: everything once more.

sections.name: StallsAgain
sections.note: Stalls, then hens after them.

sections.name: ChilliLane2
sections.note: One more chilli.

sections.name: LastRow
sections.note: One more row of stalls.

sections.name: MarketEnd
sections.note: The market thins out: a last hens' basket; if he is still ahead, he gets away at 300 m.
